name: Verdance Analytics
description: Web analytics start-up in the fictional town of Harlow Crest.

items.title: Published regulator fine
items.content: The data protection regulator publicly fined Verdance $410,000 on 2026-05-06 for setting tracking cookies without consent on 1.3 million devices. Notice VDA-REG-0506.

items.title: API rate limits
items.content: The public API allows 1,800 requests per minute per key and 75 MB of export per day. Docs page VDA-API-2.

items.title: Sprint planning schedule
items.content: Sprint planning is every second Monday at 09:35 in room Fern; the sprint board is VDA-SPR-62 and the scrum lead is Jonah Kettering.

items.title: Laptop security rules
items.content: Laptops must lock after 4 minutes and use disk encryption; lost laptops are reported to IT on extension 2286 within 2 hours. Policy VDA-SEC-15.

items.title: Series B funding terms
items.content: Halyard Ventures leads a $22M Series B at a pre-money valuation of $96M; closing is expected on 2027-01-22. Term sheet VDA-FIN-4471-H.

items.title: Customer churn list
items.content: Three accounts plan to cancel: Marisol Travel ($8,400 a month), Quire Books and Ostler Gym Group, together 11.6% of revenue. List VDA-CHN-2207-M.
